title: ToggleValue Type from connectToggleRefinement no longer exists
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

I switched from the experimental Typescript version back to the mainstream version after typings were released in the main version and now I am no long able to `import type { ToggleValue } from 'instantsearch.js/es/connectors/toggle-refinement/connectToggleRefinement';` because it doesn't exist as seen in the screenshot below showing connectToggleRefinement.d.ts.

## 🖥 Screenshot

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7559478/130681882-9b656330-2c9a-4070-9b6d-22843649e581.png)

## Environment

"instantsearch.js": "4.28.0",
